summary_en: The caller requested general servicing for an AC and initially asked for a 30-minute technician appointment on 30 October 2026 at 10:00 AM India time. The agent offered 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM slots and requested the caller's name. The caller selected 10:00 AM, provided the name Shravani, locality Madhapur, email sravani.audit@example.invalid, and phone number +12025550149, and clarified that the appliance was a window AC. The agent stated that a 10:00–10:30 AM appointment was confirmed, but incorrectly referred to split AC servicing and quoted ₹599. The caller raised the appliance and pricing discrepancy and asked for the appointment details to be sent by email. The agent corrected the service type and quoted ₹499 for window AC general servicing, stating that the appointment details had been emailed. The caller accepted the ₹499 price and repeatedly requested final confirmation. The agent again confirmed that the appointment was recorded and confirmed. The caller ended by confirming the 30 October 2026 10:00 AM India-time window AC appointment and explicitly said no callback was needed; the call ended courteously.
next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
objections: The agent initially identified the appliance as split AC instead of window AC.
The agent initially quoted ₹599 instead of the corrected ₹499 window AC service price.
